selection_rule: This registry is a development-only, one-candidate capacity study. V2.1 temporal folds are consumed development evidence; no result is a final holdout claim.
promotion_rule: A post-development final protocol is required before blocks 5 or 6 may be opened. The candidate must be assessed by fold consistency, five-seed variation, event sensitivity, FAR, parameter count, INT16 degradation, and hardware feasibility.

candidates.implementation: paper_a_multiscale_residual_1dcnn; 15/47 multiscale depthwise input branches, 1x1 mixing, residual depthwise-separable 7/5/3 refinement with dilations 1/2/4
candidates.inference_contract: raw causal 17x1280 EEG; Conv1D, depthwise Conv1D, pointwise Conv1D, BatchNorm, ReLU, AvgPool, residual add, global average pool, linear classifier
